attr.title: Broforce
attr.desc: A pixel-art run-and-gun platformer with destructible stages and action-movie heroes to rescue.
attr.inst: Requires the Steam Linux edition of Broforce. Run download_depot 274190 274193 in the Steam console and copy depot_274193 to ports/broforce/gamedata. First-time setup needs 4.5 GiB free. The port targets 64-bit ARM firmware and includes an ARM32 Unity runtime for lower-memory devices with armhf userland; it uses the ARM64 runtime when armhf glibc 2.35 is unavailable.
